oneOf.description: Tested against an official simulator or vendor sample traces.
Tested against the real machine with recorded conversations.

evidence_level.description: The evidence level the README declares.

model.description:
The model id that result deliveries and order events carry in
`source.model`: the definition's vendor/model folder key.

name.description: The model's name for people, from its README title.

protocol.description: The protocol the definition speaks; null for a blocked definition.

ready.description:
True when a `machine.toml` exists; false for a blocked definition,
whose README lists what is missing.

specimen_system.description:
The machine's own specimen code system (the namespace of an order's
`specimen_type`, ADR 0030); null when not declared.

test_system.description:
The machine's own test code system (the namespace of `test` in
results and of order tests, ADR 0029); null when not declared.

vendor.description: The vendor folder key, the part of `model` before the slash.

ModelId.description: The machine model: its definition's vendor/model folder key, for example roche/cobas-e411 (ADR 0033). Key per-model tables on it; see machines.json.

Protocol.description: The protocol keys a machine definition can name.

description: The catalog: every shipped machine model, sorted by model id.

machines.description: One entry per `machines/<vendor>/<model>/` folder, sorted by `model`.

title: Analyte machine catalog
